$comment: Hand-ruled QA cells from the archived phase-6 LOG (D498, via D493/D495): the 6 standing gate-FAIL deviations accepted inside their inherited history (or as loading-animation phase), plus the 5 out-of-range acceptances below the floor (4) and above the old ceiling (barloading hover-30). A ruled cell with px <= bound reads `ruled (<D>)` instead of FAIL and is excluded from issues. Raising a bound or adding a cell needs a D-entry. D594 (A11) re-cites the three barloading bounds: they rest on an unpinnable loading phase (D591) and mask D590, so they expire when D590 lands rather than standing as accepted deviations. In-range PASS cells named in D498 (markers legend-hover-0/1/clear, scatter/scattermultiaxis hover-70) need no ruling; the D407 choropleth race was a single event on a cell that reads 0. V4.4.
